stem:
The table shows the time Monique worked and the amount of money she earned during four different weeks.

Monique’s Earnings

| Time Worked (hours) | Amount Earned (dollars) |
|---------------------|-------------------------|
| 15                  | 123.75                  |
| 20                  | 165                     |
| 24                  | 198                     |
| 30                  | 247.50                  |

Based on the information in the table, how much will Monique earn if she works 40 hours in a week?
visual_elements: table with columns Time Worked (hours) and Amount Earned (dollars) and four rows of data: (15, 123.75), (20, 165), (24, 198), (30, 247.50)
